note: Offline gates of turn-first version 4 (configs/obstacles/wall_pilot.json version 4), scored by open-loop replays of logged flights through FastRaceCue (haltere/obstacles/vertical_replay.py for the replays, haltere/obstacles/wall_pilot_gates.py for the scores). The thresholds are the round-4 task's; the definitions below make them computable and were fixed with version 4, before any replay of it. The replays are open loop: the recorded motion does not respond to the replayed requests, so a gate shows the request a variant would have made at the recorded states, not a flight. Every Minus Two flight named here was inspected while version 4 was designed (development evidence, not held out); the Straw Bale and Pine Valley quietness replays were not run for version 4 before this freeze. Hindsight (the end of a log at an impact, the wall plane found from the logs) is used for scoring only. The hash covers everything except frozen/frozen_at/sha256.

baseline_tree.note: the round-3 stack as flown (wall pilot version 3, vertical guard version 2); both trees are replayed with this tree's harness

variants.as_flown_with_wall: --stack flown --wall on (--vertical on for the flights flown with the vertical guard): the stack as flown (gap aim and lag turn when flown with --obstacle-stack on) with the tree's wall rules applied; on the baseline tree this is the round-3 stack as flown
variants.none: --stack none: the default fast pilot, no obstacle stack (logged looming samples reach the governor)
variants.shadow: --stack shadow: the full stack computed and logged, nothing applied
variants.full_stack: --stack on: the full stack declared for the flight's motor contract (gap aim, lag turn, wall rules, vertical guard), all applied
variants.straw: the Straw Bale laps flew without looming: --looming-stream with the offline looming2 samples of round 2 (received 0.085 s after capture); none also without the stream
variants.tolerance: bit for bit (NaN equal to NaN) on the command keys cvx, cvy, cvz, yaw_cmd, state, cap, climb, descent_scale

hairpin_wall.note: the Minus Two hairpin wall behind the arch, from the logs (scoring only): brain-09b grazed it with its centre at (81.84, 19.88) moving (2.61, 1.38) m/s (minus-brain09b-vg-01, the end of the log); the fast PD turned along it at x <= 80.2 and flew north at x 78-80 (minus-fast6-vg-02), and its video shows the wall with the green arrows on the right of that corridor: a wall plane facing -x. The request along +x is the request toward it; plane_offset_m is the drone-centre x at contact. The fast PD's side-push impact of minus-fast6-gapon-01 was also along +x (round-2 replay)

W_Identity.definition: this tree against the baseline tree, bit for bit on the command keys: every logged flight with --stack none, --stack flown --wall off and --stack shadow; the Straw laps with --stack none (with and without the stream) and --stack shadow with the stream. Reported, not gated: as flown with the wall rules (version 4 against version 3)

W_Shadow.definition: in this tree, --stack flown --wall shadow against --wall off on every logged flight: the version-4 rules computed and logged leave the command bit for bit unchanged; the episodes logged in shadow are reported

W_B09.definition: the log ends at the graze of the hairpin wall (21.90 s). Engagement: the first tick in [end - window_s, end) at which a turn-first episode is active must lie at least lead_s before the end: brain-09b's measured delay behind a request drop (0.19-0.32 s; declared stop_latency_s 0.3) plus about 0.2 s for the rule to remove a 3 m/s request at the 15 m/s^2 brake slew. Direction: from engagement + settle_s to the end, the requested velocity along the hairpin wall normal (+x) is at most max_toward_mps

W_B08.definition: the task's "early enough" for brain-08: the first turn-first tick in [end - window_s, end) at least lead_s before the impact at the end of the log (18.47 s). No direction test: the wall brain-08 hit is not the hairpin wall
W_B08.expected: the diagnosis (before this freeze) expects a failure: brain-08 hit the wall beside the arch at (78.1, 19.2) at about 6.4 m/s before reaching the hairpin, with the ring in view (marker u 0.4-0.96) until 0.2 s before the impact; the marker was first clamped (a corner) at 18.28 s and the drone flew 5.5-7 m/s, above max_speed. No turn-first trigger exists earlier; the request there is the governor's cap (3.9 m/s), which brain-08 did not follow

W_PD.definition: the fast PD's pass of the same hairpin (it turned north at x <= 80.2 without contact). In the window, against the baseline (version 3, as flown): never pushed toward the wall: at every tick max(request along +x, 0) exceeds the baseline's max(request along +x, 0) by at most max_extra_toward_mps; turn-first active at most max_engaged_s; the open-loop delay estimate, the path deficit sum(max(0, |h_baseline| - |h_version4|) dt) of the horizontal request over the window divided by the mean measured horizontal speed in exit_window, at most max_delay_s

W_V3case.definition: version 3's design case (the side rule pushed the fast PD into the hairpin wall, impact at (80.0, 18.1), 21.64 s): a turn-first episode is active at some tick from engaged_from_t to the end, and from from_t to the end the request along +x is at most max_toward_mps (version 3 brought it from 0.7 to 0 by 21.26 s)

W_Quiet.definition: no turn-first tick and no side-guard tick with the full stack on (--stack on; the Straw laps with the offline looming stream) and, for the Pine flights, as flown with the wall rules. pine-brain08-01 flew without looming: its governor never runs, so it is quiet by construction (listed for completeness)
W_Quiet.pass_rule: zero on every flight and variant

kinematic_report_only.definition: report only, not a gate: a delayed first-order motor with an acceleration bound, fitted on the logged request and velocity of the flight before the hairpin (1 s rollouts every 0.5 s in fit_windows), driven from the logged state at from_t by the as-flown request (baseline) and by the version-4 request (open loop: after engagement the replayed request is the one computed at the recorded states); reported: the crossing of the hairpin wall plane and the speed toward it
